housing.summary: Numbeo reports an average monthly rent of SEK 10,027.27 for a one-bedroom apartment in Malmö city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Malmo). Boplats Syd says it is Malmö's largest housing intermediary (https://www.boplatssyd.se/lediga-hyreslagenheter-i-malmo). Hyresgästföreningen says a second-hand-rental deposit should not exceed a couple of monthly rents, but this is a ceiling rather than a single market norm, so deposit_months is null (https://www.hyresgastforeningen.se/stod-och-rad/andrahand-och-inneboende/hyra-en-lagenhet-i-andra-hand/).

banking.summary: A newcomer without Mobile BankID must visit a Nordea branch, identify themselves and explain their banking needs.
required_docs: Valid identity document; without a Swedish personal identity number, a foreign passport
Current notice of tax assessment (A-skattsedel) if the applicant has a coordination number
Documents showing source of funds if requested, such as bank statements
University or college admission letter showing course duration for a foreign student

schools.summary: Malmö's municipal international-schools directory lists English-language municipal and independent schools. Malmö International School offers IB PYP and MYP; Malmö Borgarskola offers the IB Diploma; Bladins International School follows IB curricula.

legal_admin.summary: A person moving to Sweden for one year or more should notify the Swedish Tax Agency through the Moving to Sweden service, then book and attend an in-person identity check at a state service centre with original identity documents.
legal_admin.registration_step: Notify the Swedish Tax Agency of the move and complete the booked in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre.

tax_finance.summary: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a personal identity number when a newcomer is entered in the Swedish Population Register; it is used as the person's identifier with authorities and companies.

transport.summary: Skånetrafiken is Region Skåne's public-transport operator for city buses, regional buses, Pågatåg and Öresundståg (https://www.skane.se/om-region-skane/kollektivtrafik/). The adult 30-day pass covering all of Skåne costs SEK 685 from 1 July through 31 December 2026 (https://www.svt.se/nyheter/lokalt/skane/priset-pa-manadskort-halveras-i-skane). Driving-licence exchange rules are published by the Swedish Transport Agency (https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/). Healthcare-centre registration in Skåne is through 1177 e-services or a form (https://vard.skane.se/primarvarden/ditt-besok-hos-oss/valj-oss/).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EEA licence remains valid in Sweden and may be exchanged if the holder is permanently resident; most non-EEA licences cannot be exchanged, except licences from the United Kingdom, Faroe Islands, Switzerland or Japan under stated conditions.
transport.healthcare_registration: Choose (list with) a Skåne healthcare centre through 1177 e-services or by submitting a form printed online or obtained from the chosen clinic.
